Error.*: the error marker's record equality and printing, compiler-generated; the conversions it exists for are claimed through Result
None.*: the None marker's record equality and printing, compiler-generated
Success.*: the success marker's record equality and printing, compiler-generated
ResultState.*: enum members; what each state means is claimed through the members that read it
AbstractAttribute..ctor: a constraint attribute's constructor; what it constrains is CMTK0010's, held by the analyzer tests
ConcreteAttribute..ctor: a constraint attribute's constructor; what it constrains is CMTK0010's, held by the analyzer tests
DistinctAttribute..ctor: a constraint attribute's constructor; what it constrains is CMTK0010's, held by the analyzer tests
ClosedSetAttribute..ctor: a constraint attribute's constructor; what it constrains is CMTK0010's, held by the analyzer tests
GeneratedClosedSetAttribute.*: plumbing the generators write on a closed set, read by the satellites through Accept
GeneratedValueObjectAttribute.*: plumbing the generators write on a value object, read by the satellites through Accept
GeneratedMemberAttribute.*: plumbing the generators write on every member they introduce, naming its contract; that each carries it and no hand-written one does is GeneratedMemberAttributeTests', and no document promises more yet (decision 128)
GeneratedClosedSets.*: refusal helpers that generated closed-set code calls; what they refuse is claimed through Parse and the JSON reads
IStoredJsonConverterSource.CreateStoredJ: plumbing StoredJsonConverterFactory calls on a generated converter
DescribedJsonSchema.ExporterOptions: the exporter options the schema descriptions are read with, plumbing
TypeKitServiceCollectionExtensions.AddEn: the internal-service-provider form of UseTypeKit, whose claims hold it
TypeKitAssertionException..ctor: the exception the assertions throw; its messages are claimed through the assertions
